title: Bundle of dependencies updates (Docker, Python, Java)
author: olivi-eh
body:
This PR updates dependencies:
- Docker
- Python
- Java

It's a bundle of a handful of PRs that are currently up that were all failing for a long time because they needed manual interventions:
- https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/bank-of-anthos/pull/2235
- https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/bank-of-anthos/pull/2274
- https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/bank-of-anthos/pull/2383
